mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process by which atmospheric nitrogen is converted into plant available forms."
Biological nitrogen fixation is the process by which atmospheric nitrogen is converted into plant available forms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fourth most abundant element in earth's crust."
Iron is the fourth most abundant element in earth's crust.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the study of microorganisms that live in the soil; their metabolic activity, their roles in energy flow, and importance in nutrient cycling."
Soil Microbiology is defined as the study of microorganisms that live in the soil; their metabolic activity, their roles in energy flow, and importance in nutrient cycling.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the process in which nitrate and ammonium are taken up by soil organisms and therefore become unavailable to crops."
Immobilisation refers to the process in which nitrate and ammonium are taken up by soil organisms and therefore become unavailable to crops.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an element essential to life."
Sulphur is an element essential to life.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the disciplines of soil science and closely related with soil microbiology (one of the major disciplines in soil science)."
Soil Biochemistry is one of the disciplines of soil science and closely related with soil microbiology (one of the major disciplines in soil science).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a natural medium that supports plant growth on the earth surface, that is, it is both biologically active and living."
Soil is defined as a natural medium that supports plant growth on the earth surface, that is, it is both biologically active and living.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an energy - intensive process and until recently was performed only by selected bacteria and cyanobacteria."
Nitrogen fixation is an energy - intensive process and until recently was performed only by selected bacteria and cyanobacteria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the best indications of good soil health (nutrition and structure)."
Soil organic matter is one of the best indications of good soil health (nutrition and structure).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an element essential to life."
Phosphorus is an element essential to life.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mutualistic (symbiotic) interaction between two organisms rather than between populations."
Symbiotic nitrogen fixation is a mutualistic (symbiotic) interaction between two organisms rather than between populations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount in moles or grams of reacting particles transformed or products formed per unit time."
The rate of reaction is the amount in moles or grams of reacting particles transformed or products formed per unit time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the 1st step towards root colonisation in the soil."
Seed colonisation is the 1st step towards root colonisation in the soil.

rhizosphere

______ are the primary source of reduced carbon for the soil microbial community, and the plant growth is also linked by the availability of N and P.
Plants
Plants are the primary source of reduced carbon for the soil microbial community, and the plant growth is also linked by the availability of N and P.
______ is a compound that slows down the rate of an enzyme catalysed reaction.
inhibitor
An inhibitor is a compound that slows down the rate of an enzyme catalysed reaction.

Denitrification
Denitrification is the reduction of nitrates back into the largely inert nitrogen gas (N2), completing the nitrogen cycle.

largest global reservoir of P
The largest global reservoir of P is the ocean sediment pool which represents a small but steady sink for terrestrial P released by the weathering of minerals or released by the biota.

Nodule effectiveness is the ability of the symbiotic system when formed to take up (assimilate) molecular N.
______ is the process by which nitrogen is converted between its various chemical forms.
nitrogen cycle
The nitrogen cycle is the process by which nitrogen is converted between its various chemical forms.
______ is defined as the continuous or progressive development of an organism.
Growth
Growth is defined as the continuous or progressive development of an organism.
______ is an essential element for all living organisms not just soil microorganisms.
Nitrogen
Nitrogen is an essential element for all living organisms not just soil microorganisms.
______ is the process by which phosphorus is converted between its chemical forms.
phosphorus cycle
The phosphorus cycle is the process by which phosphorus is converted between its chemical forms.
______ is a natural medium that supports plant and animal life on the surface of the earth and is both active biologically and living.
soil habitat
The soil habitat is a natural medium that supports plant and animal life on the surface of the earth and is both active biologically and living.
